t: This sculpture is Nexus, made by Alan Thornhill, a British artist who lived from 1921 to 2020. Thornhill came to sculpture through pottery, and clay stayed central to his work for a long time. His output ranges from pottery and sculpture, small and large, to portrait heads, paintings and drawings. He developed methods that did without an armature, so that he could improvise as he worked. His portraiture is known for rigorous observation, and that same close looking is worth bringing to this piece.
